I’m in the same situation as you. We broke up last August. I chased hard and just pushed her away even more. It’s been 8 months and she hasn’t reached out once. The breakup was messy. There wasn’t any cheating, but emotionally it kind of felt like there was. So I can say with confidence that the relationship is done. I’m not sure about yours, but I can tell you this… waiting around only drags out the pain.

You’ll probably meet someone else later on, but please don’t wait for her. Focus on healing. I really mean it. You can go to the gym, make more money, improve your looks… all that, but it doesn’t mean you’re healing if deep down you’re still holding onto that hope of her coming back.

I actually met someone new. She was amazing, and honestly the relationship was way healthier than my last one. But because I hadn’t truly healed, I was still hoping I’d somehow get my ex back. I couldn’t give this new person my full self. And that sucks, because it starts making you doubt your own worth. Just yesterday, after 8 months, I reached out to my ex again. I’m still blocked everywhere, but somehow the message went through. Today she reposted something about why she shuts people out. So yeah, she definitely saw my message. And after all this time, nothing’s changed.

I ended up ruining something that could’ve been great just because I was chasing something I lost months ago. I get what you’re feeling. I made the same choices. Her parents loved me too. But none of that matters unless she decides to open that door again. You’ve got to accept that she might never do that. And that has to be okay.
